title: Extend: API, Embedding and Multi-Agent
brief: (a) Write a script that starts a conversation against the Meridian agent, polls
correctly at a 2 second interval with a cap, retrieves the SQL and the result set,
then asks a follow-up on the SAME conversation_id. Report your poll-loop overhead
(b) Export the agent's serialized_space, change one instruction, re-import it as a
second agent, and diff the two configurations.
Part (b) is how a Genie Agent becomes reviewable in version control instead of a thing
someone configured in a browser once.
NOTE ON GRADING. The script is the deliverable, and a person reads it. The checks below only confirm the agent it runs against exists.

checks.name: Prerequisite: it carries instructions to modify and diff

review: The poll loop uses a fixed interval with a cap, and is instrumented as its own span.
The follow-up reuses conversation_id rather than starting a new conversation.
The diff shows exactly one intended difference, and no accidental ones.
Poll-loop overhead is reported separately from Genie's time.
